news.title: Engineers make quality, low-cost carbon fiber from coproducts of paper, energy production
news.summary_en: Iowa State researchers are taking their innovations for producing high-performance, high-value biobased carbon fiber from batch production in a lab to commercially relevant continuous production.

news.title: When Wall Street (almost) never sleeps
news.summary_en: Wall Street is preparing to stay awake longer. As major exchanges move toward a 23-hours-a-day, five-days-a-week trading schedule, Iowa State finance researcher Bidisha Chakrabarty discusses the shift to expanded trading hours, why it's happening, and the opportunities, risks and realities behind an always-on market.

news.title: Borlaug lecture features researcher’s success expanding nutrition sources in Africa
news.summary_en: Afokpe, a plant breeder and product specialist at East-West Seed International based in Benin, West Africa, discuss her work developing climate-resistant vegetables that have improved food and nutrition security across the region.

news.title: How the super El Niño could affect fall fertilizer’s all-important timing
news.summary_en: Super El Niño-influenced weather could make Iowa’s fall wetter and warmer than usual. Iowa State University experts say that may pose challenges for fall fertilizer applications.
